# Personal AI Philosophy Statements {#sec-philosophies}

> *Having examined the research pipeline together, where does each of us now
> stand?*

The preceding chapters record where the seminar converged as a group. This
chapter records where its members stand individually.

Alongside the shared guide, participants wrote personal AI philosophy
statements: short, signed accounts of how each of us intends to use — and refuse
to use — AI in our own research. Each statement is reproduced in full below and
is free to share, quote, or adapt.
